name: Sentinel detection coverage
description: Rule coverage against ATT&CK 19.2 — generated by services/detect/cmd/sigmac-gen, not hand-edited.

techniques.comment: Covered by: Impossible travel between sign-ins, Remote PowerShell access enabled for a mailbox user, Sign-in using a legacy authentication protocol
Covered by: Sign-in through a known anonymiser or proxy
Covered by: Account password set to never expire, SharePoint site permission level changed
Covered by: Credential added to an application's service principal, New application registration created
Covered by: Full access permission granted on another mailbox

Covered by: External guest granted access to a SharePoint site, High-privilege permission granted to a user-assigned application, Member added to a privileged group, Privileged directory role assignment, Site collection administrator added, Tenant-wide admin consent granted to an application
Covered by: New device registered to Azure AD, New mobile device linked to a mailbox
Covered by: Password spray against multiple accounts from one source
Covered by: Inbound or outbound mail connector added, Mailbox content exported to a local file
Covered by: Mass mailbox item access within a short window
Covered by: Mail flow rule created to forward mail externally, New inbox forwarding rule to an external address
Covered by: Guest account added to a privileged directory role
Covered by: eDiscovery content search created
Covered by: Domain federation settings changed, Trusted network location added to sign-in policy
Covered by: High-privilege permission granted to an application, OAuth consent grant to an unverified application
Covered by: Mass file download or deletion within a short window
Covered by: MFA method registration outside business hours, Multi-factor authentication disabled for a user
Covered by: Inbox rule created to hide incoming messages
Covered by: Anonymous sharing link created for a file
Covered by: Repeated MFA prompt failures for one account
Covered by: Conditional access policy disabled, Data loss prevention policy disabled, Safe attachments protection disabled
Covered by: Mailbox audit bypass enabled for an account, Mailbox audit logging disabled

legendItems.label: Covered by at least one rule
